snippet.title: Luna Abyss | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description:
Luna Abyss is a narrative-driven, first-person action-adventure game, with fluid platforming and bullet hell combat, where you explore an impossible megastructure deep inside an alien moon, all whilst serving a prison life sentence.

You play as Fawkes, a prisoner condemned to explore a derelict megastructure that sprawls deep beneath the surface of the mimic moon Luna. Guided by the artificial warden Aylin, you descend into a colossal, crumbling megastructure known as the Abyss - a world of lost technology, alien ruins, and cosmic horror. 

Gameplay blends first-person shooting, bullet-hell combat, and platforming traversal. Dodge dense projectile patterns, leap across shifting architecture, and solve environmental puzzles to uncover new paths. Every descent brings revelations about Luna’s forgotten colony and your own mysterious connection to its past. 

Haunting visuals, rich sound design, and a compelling narrative make Luna Abyss a tense and atmospheric descent into a world unlike any other.
